# lexer

## Overview
Generated JFlex lexer implementations (_DartLexer, _DartDocLexer) for tokenizing Dart source code and DartDoc comments.

## Interface
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.lexer._DartLexer
- com.jetbrains.lang.dart.lexer._DartDocLexer

## Invariants
- Implements com.intellij.lexer.FlexLexer interface.
- Auto-generated by JFlex from Dart.flex and DartDoc.flex; manual changes should be made to flex files.

## Side Effects
- Mutates internal DFA state during token scanning (advance()).
